queue.title: Import queue
queue.emptyBody: Added PST files show their progress here.

log.title: Error log
log.pick: Select a PST file to see its log.
log.none: No errors or warnings for this PST file.

empty.title: No PST imported yet
empty.body: Choose “Add PST files” to import Outlook PST files. Large files work: the import runs in the background.

remove.title: Remove “{{name}}”?
remove.body: This PST file brought {{n}} messages. Messages that exist only in this PST file are deleted. Messages also found in other PST files are kept. The PST file itself is not changed.
